arguments.text: Good start. Settle now to race pace, long smooth strokes.

10 km, ten 1000 m out-and-back legs. Settle at about critical power (pod about 175 W shaft, boat about 108 W) after the hard start; keep pod reserve above 40 pct until 2 km to go, then spend it; final sprint at about 400 m to go. Check legs in the same direction to separate current from paddler. Watch for instrument drift (pod vs GPS disagreement) and incidents (weed on rudder: speed drops at same power).

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; strongly negative = extra drag (weed, rudder) or pod reading high

arguments.name: boat_over_pod
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; jumps if pod drifts or drag changes

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power plus current predicts: weed, drag, or pod drift

arguments.text: min 1: start hot (pod 230 W vs CP 173). Cued ease, target 161 s/500 ground. Defined drag_gap = push_local - push_along (extra drag watch) and boat_over_pod = boat power / pod power (about 0.65 at start). Watches: pod_reserve_low (<0.3), extra_drag (drag_gap < -0.25 for 30 s). Wakes at 2000 m and 450 m to go.

text: Cued ease to settle after the hot start; set plan, watches for low reserve and extra drag, wakes at 2000 m and 450 m.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Smooth and long, it is a long race.

arguments.reason: check effort after first turn, against the current

text: Cued ease again: pod 193 W still above critical power 173 W with pod reserve at 44 pct after 4 min; wake after the turn to check.

arguments.text: Ease to two fifty pace this leg. Save it for later.

arguments.reason: after turn 2: retarget pace for the leg with the current

arguments.text: min 6: paddler held pod 190-196 W for 4 min (CP 173), says 7/10 hard but holding. Pod reserve 31 pct, boat reserve 14 pct. Two ease cues mostly ignored. Cued ease with pace 170 s/500 ground on leg 2 (current against about -0.1). If paddler holds 190+ W with no fade and low effort, CP may be underestimated; consider set_critical_power later with evidence.

text: Cued ease with pace target 170 s/500: pod still 13 pct above critical power, reserve 31 pct; wake after the next turn to retarget.
no cue: low-reserve alert already answered by the ease cue 21 s ago; waiting to see it act.

arguments.text: That is it. Hold this effort through the turn and beyond.

min 9.2: paddler finally at about CP (pod 177-179 W vs 173). Pod reserve 19 pct, boat reserve 2 pct. fade -4.6 pct is likely from the ease (same rate, less power), not fatigue. Cued hold effort (no pace) so the 170 s/500 target does not carry past the turn into the leg with the current. Target pod 172-178 W until 2 km to go.

text: Cued hold: paddler now at about critical power on the pod; hold effort rather than the old pace target through the turn.
no cue: pod steady at 177 W, about critical power, holding effort after the turn as asked; boat reserve reads empty but it counts current as paddler, pod reserve 18 pct.

arguments.text: Ease just a little. You are on the edge, stay smooth.

arguments.reason: check pod power after the ease and the turn

arguments.text: min 14: pod crept back up 177 -> 188 W after the hold faded; pod reserve 7.5 pct, empties in 250 m. Cued ease (no pace, turn in 300 m). Paddler drifts up to about 190 W on their own; expect to re-cue every few minutes.

text: Cued ease: pod power drifted to 188 W above critical power with pod reserve at 7.5 pct; check again after the turn.

arguments.reason: recheck big GPS speed drop on leg 4 once the turn is out of the 30-s means: turn, current, weed or pod drift?

text: no cue: GPS speed fell from 3.45 to 2.62 m/s at the same pod power and rate just after turn 3; 30-s means still contain the turn, rechecking in 45 s.

arguments.text: Clear the rudder now. One back-stroke, then straight back to rhythm.

arguments.reason: did clear_rudder restore speed on leg 4? compare GPS speed at same pod power

arguments.text: min 16.3: leg 4 (back) GPS 2.71 m/s at pod 191 W, push_local -0.53; expected about -0.21 from legs 1-3 (current growing: out legs +0.16 then +0.28; back leg 2 -0.09). About 0.3 m/s unexplained: weed, wind shift or pod drift. Paddler 7/10 hard but holding, no mention of rudder. Cued clear_rudder. Also: pod reserve hit 0 at min 15.5 at about 190 W and paddler not forced down yet -> pod CP 173 may be low; revisit.

text: Cued clear_rudder: boat 0.3 m/s slower than pod power and the growing current predict on leg 4; a back-stroke is cheap against that loss.

arguments.reason: check whether the rudder back-stroke happened and speed recovered on leg 4

text: no cue: clear_rudder cue 30 s ago, no back-stroke seen yet; rechecking in 50 s.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging. Do one back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

arguments.reason: second clear_rudder: did the back-stroke happen, did GPS speed recover

text: Repeated clear_rudder: first one not followed (no back-stroke seen), boat still 0.25 m/s slower than expected at same pod power.

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 9000 m
cue gate open: tell paddler the new finish (9000 m) and check speed after the rudder back-stroke

arguments.text: min 18.4: RADIO: course shortened by one leg, finish at 9000 m (set_race_distance done). Must tell paddler (tell, distance_left_m). Second clear_rudder was followed (back-stroke seen, 36 pct dip) at min 17.9; check if GPS speed on leg 4 recovers toward about 2.9 m/s at 190 W.

RACE NOW 9000 m (radio, min 18.4): nine 1000 m legs, finish at the far end after leg 9. Hold pod about 175-185 W (pod CP 173 may be low: paddler held 190 W with pod reserve empty and not forced down). Spend effort a little more on legs against the current (back legs, current about 0.2-0.3 m/s and growing), a little less on out legs. Final push from about 1500 m to go, finish sprint about 400 m to go. Leg 4: boat was 0.25 m/s slower than expected; clear_rudder back-stroke done min 17.9 - verify.

text: no cue yet (gate shut 34 s): set race distance to 9000 m per radio, updated plan, wake when the gate opens to tell the paddler.
